title: Ghost Interviewer Now Installs Like a Real App | vitalii.no
description:
How a progressive web app with an offline-ready shell turned a browser tab people kept losing into a one-tap home-screen app on both Android and iPhone.

Before an interview you want one thing on your phone: the app, open, ready — not buried in a browser tab that a reload could wipe mid-call. iOS has no native install prompt at all, so most people who tried Ghost Interviewer on a phone just kept it as a bookmark and lost it the moment the tab closed.

A device check now shows an install button that calls the browser's native install prompt on Android and Chrome, and falls back to iOS's manual 'Add to Home Screen' steps where no install API exists. A web app manifest declares a standalone app with 192 and 512 pixel icons, and a service worker caches the app shell with a network-first, cache-fallback strategy, so a weak connection still shows the app instead of a blank reload. The service worker only registers in production.

The interview screen now opens from a home-screen icon in one tap on both Android and iOS.
